stem: Which sentence best supports the idea that chickadees take action to keep their bodies warm at night?

options.label: A
options.text: This means that sometimes there is well over a 100-degree difference between a chickadee's body and the air temperature only an inch away. (paragraph 3)

options.label: B
options.text: Without any feathered insulation, heat would quickly be lost and much energy wasted in attempting to keep their toes as warm as the rest of the body. (paragraph 6)

options.label: C
options.text: Since they don't have crops in which they can store food to eat later, they must eat enough each day to survive the long, 18-hour night. (paragraph 9)

options.label: D
options.text: They do not roost together in flocks as some birds do but spend the night alone. (paragraph 10)
